*[[Faveo's Daggers]] ([[unique]])

==Notes==
*If seeking to capture this boss' elite skill, consider bringing along an extra [[Signet of Capture]], as [[Chimor the Lightblooded]] is nearby and is the only boss who carries [[Mark of Insecurity]].

==Trivia==
*His name can loosely be translated from [[w:Latin|Latin]] as "I favor attacking". Note that both words are in the present indicative, meaning that a more literal translation is "I like/favor, I attack".
